Exercise: Side to Side Box Shuffle

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- lateral_movement_with_jumping
- landing

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- adductors
- calves
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_explosive_power
- enhance_lateral_stability_and_agility

Contraindications:

- Recent lower body injury
- Chronic knee or ankle issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single Leg Box Shuffle, primaryMuscles: ['quadriceps', 'hamstrings']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Side to Side Hop, equipment: no equipment

Instructions:

- Stand to one side of the box with your left foot resting on the middle of it.
- To begin, jump up and over to the other side of the box, landing with your right foot on top of the box and your left foot on the floor. Swing your arms to aid your movement.
- Continue shuffling back and forth across the box.
